briefdescription.para: Unit tests for EPIC-004 Phase 1: AQL 2.0.0 DML mutation parser.

detaileddescription.para: Covers all five mutation types (INSERT, UPDATE, REMOVE/DELETE, REPLACE, UPSERT) in both AQL-native and SQL-style surface forms, plus AqlSafetyValidator ValidationMode::AllowMutations and backward-compatibility guards.

simplesect.para: Phase 1 is parser-only — no execution semantics are tested here.
